notes: All seven episodes (271, 272, 273, 276, 277, 279, 280) have filename dates confirmed by on-air cues (Rosh Chodesh Nissan, one week before Pesach, Rosh Chodesh Iyar, mid-Sefirah/Pirkei Avos ch. 5, one week before Erev Shavuos, right after Shavuos). Episode 272 announces a two-week Pesach break, which explains the gap to 273 (04-28-87).

Part 2 should be in the same Heritage folder and in episode 281 (catalog '#2'); link them in pass 2. The story is told of Rabbi Akiva here; the classic version usually names an unnamed sage.

Mitzvah Time Havdalah series: 'Havdalah 276' (cbefd2fcab) -> phone-quiz review in 277 (not clipped) -> 'Havdalah-2 280' (542cf9e061). Linked cbefd2fcab and 542cf9e061 with part_of_set/continues (content evidence).

Episode 273 story 'The Flickering Flame' features 'a great tzaddik called Rabbi Yisrael' and a shoemaker ('as long as the candle burns, one can still repair'); this tale is usually told of Rabbi Yisrael Salanter, who is not in the people vocabulary. Not named on air, so left as a character.
Episode 271 and 280 both teach the song 'Ad Mosai' (271 introduces it, 280 repeats it by request); ASR renders the sung chorus as long 'ai ai ai' loops in both.
Episode 272 includes a taped thank-you message from a teacher in Sydney after a refuah shleimah request (health_info in hidden); she is the teacher of the 271 Shema guest.
